Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.controllers

Class BorrowRequestController

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.controllers.BorrowRequestController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/borrowrequests") public class BorrowRequestController extends Object
Controller for managing borrow requests. Handles creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting borrow requests.
